newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 15.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 15.

text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported on Kuku Radio at noon on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament approved changes to the alcohol excise tax law, which will increase imported and Saku beer prices from July.
- EU membership depends on the development of the states which have applied for entry, EU Commissioner, Hans van den Broek told news conference.
- The leading hotel, Hotel Olumpia, has started to renovate its facade.
